verses.original: מֹאזְנֵ֣י מִ֭רְמָה תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה וְאֶ֖בֶן שְׁלֵמָ֣ה רְצוֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: mō·zə·nê mir·māh tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh wə·’e·ḇen šə·lê·māh rə·ṣō·w·nōw
verses.literal: Dishonest scales are an abomination to the LORD but an accurate weight is His delight

verses.original: בָּֽא־ זָ֭דוֹן וַיָּבֹ֣א קָל֑וֹן וְֽאֶת־ צְנוּעִ֥ים חָכְמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bā- zā·ḏō·wn way·yā·ḇō qā·lō·wn wə·’eṯ- ṣə·nū·‘îm ḥāḵ·māh
verses.literal: When pride comes disgrace follows but with humility comes wisdom

verses.original: תֻּמַּ֣ת יְשָׁרִ֣ים תַּנְחֵ֑ם וְסֶ֖לֶף בּוֹגְדִ֣ים וְשַׁדָּם׃
verses.transliteration: tum·maṯ yə·šā·rîm tan·ḥêm wə·se·lep̄ bō·wḡ·ḏîm wə·šad·då̄m
verses.literal: The integrity of the upright guides them but the perversity of the faithless destroys them

verses.original: לֹא־ יוֹעִ֣יל ה֭וֹן בְּי֣וֹם עֶבְרָ֑ה וּ֝צְדָקָ֗ה תַּצִּ֥יל מִמָּֽוֶת׃
verses.transliteration: lō- yō·w·‘îl hō·wn bə·yō·wm ‘eḇ·rāh ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh taṣ·ṣîl mim·mā·weṯ
verses.literal: Riches are worthless in the day of wrath but righteousness brings deliverance from death

verses.original: צִדְקַ֣ת תָּ֭מִים תְּיַשֵּׁ֣ר דַּרְכּ֑וֹ וּ֝בְרִשְׁעָת֗וֹ יִפֹּ֥ל רָשָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: ṣiḏ·qaṯ tā·mîm tə·yaš·šêr dar·kōw ū·ḇə·riš·‘ā·ṯōw yip·pōl rā·šā‘
verses.literal: The righteousness of the blameless directs their path but the wicked fall by their own wickedness

verses.original: צִדְקַ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תַּצִּילֵ֑ם וּ֝בְהַוַּ֗ת בֹּגְדִ֥ים יִלָּכֵֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ṣiḏ·qaṯ yə·šā·rîm taṣ·ṣî·lêm ū·ḇə·haw·waṯ bō·ḡə·ḏîm yil·lā·ḵê·ḏū
verses.literal: The righteousness of the upright delivers them but the faithless are trapped by their own desires

verses.original: בְּמ֤וֹת אָדָ֣ם רָ֭שָׁע תֹּאבַ֣ד תִּקְוָ֑ה וְתוֹחֶ֖לֶת אוֹנִ֣ים אָבָֽדָה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·mō·wṯ ’ā·ḏām rā·šā‘ tō·ḇaḏ tiq·wāh wə·ṯō·w·ḥe·leṯ ’ō·w·nîm ’ā·ḇā·ḏāh
verses.literal: When the wicked man dies his hope perishes and the hope of his strength vanishes

verses.original: צַ֭דִּיק מִצָּרָ֣ה נֶחֱלָ֑ץ וַיָּבֹ֖א רָשָׁ֣ע תַּחְתָּֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: ṣad·dîq miṣ·ṣā·rāh ne·ḥĕ·lāṣ way·yā·ḇō rā·šā‘ taḥ·tāw
verses.literal: The righteous man is delivered from trouble in his place the wicked man goes in

verses.original: בְּפֶ֗ה חָ֭נֵף יַשְׁחִ֣ת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּ֝בְדַ֗עַת צַדִּיקִ֥ים יֵחָלֵֽצוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·p̄eh ḥā·nêp̄ yaš·ḥiṯ rê·‘ê·hū ū·ḇə·ḏa·‘aṯ ṣad·dî·qîm yê·ḥā·lê·ṣū
verses.literal: With his mouth the ungodly man destroys his neighbor but through knowledge the righteous are rescued

verses.original: בְּט֣וּב צַ֭דִּיקִים תַּעֲלֹ֣ץ קִרְיָ֑ה וּבַאֲבֹ֖ד רְשָׁעִ֣ים רִנָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṭūḇ ṣad·dî·qîm ta·‘ă·lōṣ qir·yāh ū·ḇa·’ă·ḇōḏ rə·šā·‘îm rin·nāh
verses.literal: When the righteous thrive the city rejoices and when the wicked perish there are shouts of joy

verses.original: בְּבִרְכַּ֣ת יְ֭שָׁרִים תָּר֣וּם קָ֑רֶת וּבְפִ֥י רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים תֵּהָרֵֽס׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ḇir·kaṯ yə·šā·rîm tā·rūm qā·reṯ ū·ḇə·p̄î rə·šā·‘îm tê·hā·rês
verses.literal: By the blessing of the upright a city is built up but by the mouth of the wicked it is torn down

verses.original: בָּז־ לְרֵעֵ֥הוּ חֲסַר־ לֵ֑ב וְאִ֖ישׁ תְּבוּנ֣וֹת יַחֲרִֽישׁ׃
verses.transliteration: bāz- lə·rê·‘ê·hū ḥă·sar- lêḇ wə·’îš tə·ḇū·nō·wṯ ya·ḥă·rîš
verses.literal: Whoever shows contempt for his neighbor lacks judgment but a man of understanding remains silent

verses.original: הוֹלֵ֣ךְ רָ֭כִיל מְגַלֶּה־ סּ֑וֹד וְנֶאֱמַן־ ר֝֗וּחַ מְכַסֶּ֥ה דָבָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w·lêḵ rā·ḵîl mə·ḡal·leh- sō·wḏ wə·ne·’ĕ·man- rū·aḥ mə·ḵas·seh ḏā·ḇār
verses.literal: A gossip reveals a secret but a trustworthy person keeps a confidence

verses.original: בְּאֵ֣ין תַּ֭חְבֻּלוֹת יִפָּל־ עָ֑ם וּ֝תְשׁוּעָ֗ה בְּרֹ֣ב יוֹעֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: bə·’ên taḥ·bu·lō·wṯ yip·pāl- ‘ām ū·ṯə·šū·‘āh bə·rōḇ yō·w·‘êṣ
verses.literal: For lack of guidance a nation falls but with many counselors comes deliverance

verses.original: רַע־ יֵ֭רוֹעַ כִּי־ עָ֣רַב זָ֑ר וְשֹׂנֵ֖א תֹקְעִ֣ים בּוֹטֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: ra‘- yê·rō·w·a‘ kî- ‘ā·raḇ zār wə·śō·nê ṯō·qə·‘îm bō·w·ṭê·aḥ
verses.literal: He who puts up security for a stranger will surely suffer . . . but the one who hates indebtedness is secure

verses.original: אֵֽשֶׁת־ חֵ֭ן תִּתְמֹ֣ךְ כָּב֑וֹד וְ֝עָרִיצִ֗ים יִתְמְכוּ־ עֹֽשֶׁר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ê·šeṯ- ḥên tiṯ·mōḵ kā·ḇō·wḏ wə·‘ā·rî·ṣîm yiṯ·mə·ḵū- ‘ō·šer
verses.literal: A gracious woman attains honor but ruthless men gain only wealth

verses.original: גֹּמֵ֣ל נַ֭פְשׁוֹ אִ֣ישׁ חָ֑סֶד וְעֹכֵ֥ר שְׁ֝אֵר֗וֹ אַכְזָרִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: gō·mêl nap̄·šōw ’îš ḥā·seḏ wə·‘ō·ḵêr šə·ʾē·rô ’aḵ·zā·rî
verses.literal: A kind man benefits himself but a cruel man brings trouble on himself

verses.original: רָשָׁ֗ע עֹשֶׂ֥ה פְעֻלַּת־ שָׁ֑קֶר וְזֹרֵ֥עַ צְ֝דָקָ֗ה שֶׂ֣כֶר אֱמֶֽת׃
verses.transliteration: rā·šā‘ ‘ō·śeh p̄ə·‘ul·laṯ- šā·qer wə·zō·rê·a‘ ṣə·ḏā·qāh śe·ḵer ’ĕ·meṯ
verses.literal: The wicked man earns an empty wage but he who sows righteousness reaps a true reward

verses.original: כֵּן־ צְדָקָ֥ה לְחַיִּ֑ים וּמְרַדֵּ֖ף רָעָ֣ה לְמוֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kên- ṣə·ḏā·qāh lə·ḥay·yîm ū·mə·rad·dêp̄ rā·‘āh lə·mō·w·ṯōw
verses.literal: Genuine righteousness leads to life but the pursuit of evil brings death

verses.original: תּוֹעֲבַ֣ת יְ֭הוָה עִקְּשֵׁי־ לֵ֑ב וּ֝רְצוֹנ֗וֹ תְּמִ֣ימֵי דָֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: tō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ‘iq·qə·šê- lêḇ ū·rə·ṣō·w·nōw tə·mî·mê ḏā·reḵ
verses.literal: The perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD but the blameless in their walk are His delight

verses.original: יָ֣ד לְ֭יָד לֹא־ יִנָּ֣קֶה רָּ֑ע וְזֶ֖רַע צַדִּיקִ֣ים נִמְלָֽט׃
verses.transliteration: yāḏ lə·yāḏ lō- yin·nā·qeh rā‘ wə·ze·ra‘ ṣad·dî·qîm nim·lāṭ
verses.literal: Be assured . . . that the wicked will not go unpunished but the offspring of the righteous will escape

verses.original: נֶ֣זֶם זָ֭הָב בְּאַ֣ף חֲזִ֑יר אִשָּׁ֥ה יָ֝פָ֗ה וְסָ֣רַת טָֽעַם׃
verses.transliteration: ne·zem zā·hāḇ bə·’ap̄ ḥă·zîr ’iš·šāh yā·p̄āh wə·sā·raṯ ṭā·‘am
verses.literal: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion

verses.original: תַּאֲוַ֣ת צַדִּיקִ֣ים אַךְ־ ט֑וֹב תִּקְוַ֖ת רְשָׁעִ֣ים עֶבְרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ta·’ă·waṯ ṣad·dî·qîm ’aḵ- ṭō·wḇ tiq·waṯ rə·šā·‘îm ‘eḇ·rāh
verses.literal: The desire of the righteous leads only to good but the hope of the wicked brings wrath

verses.original: יֵ֣שׁ מְ֭פַזֵּר וְנוֹסָ֥ף ע֑וֹד וְחוֹשֵׂ֥ךְ מִ֝יֹּ֗שֶׁר אַךְ־ לְמַחְסֽוֹר׃
verses.transliteration: yêš mə·p̄az·zêr wə·nō·w·sāp̄ ‘ō·wḏ wə·ḥō·w·śêḵ mî·yō·šer ’aḵ- lə·maḥ·sō·wr
verses.literal: One gives freely yet gains even more another withholds what is right only to become poor

verses.original: נֶֽפֶשׁ־ בְּרָכָ֥ה תְדֻשָּׁ֑ן וּ֝מַרְוֶ֗ה גַּם־ ה֥וּא יוֹרֶֽא׃
verses.transliteration: ne·p̄eš- bə·rā·ḵāh ṯə·ḏuš·šān ū·mar·weh gam- hū yō·w·re
verses.literal: A generous soul will prosper and he who refreshes others . . . will himself be refreshed

verses.original: מֹ֣נֵֽעַ בָּ֭ר יִקְּבֻ֣הוּ לְא֑וֹם וּ֝בְרָכָ֗ה לְרֹ֣אשׁ מַשְׁבִּֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: mō·nê·a‘ bār yiq·qə·ḇu·hū lə·’ō·wm ū·ḇə·rā·ḵāh lə·rōš maš·bîr
verses.literal: The people will curse the hoarder of grain but blessing will crown the one who sells it

verses.original: שֹׁ֣חֵֽר ט֭וֹב יְבַקֵּ֣שׁ רָצ֑וֹן וְדֹרֵ֖שׁ רָעָ֣ה תְבוֹאֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: šō·ḥêr ṭō·wḇ yə·ḇaq·qêš rā·ṣō·wn wə·ḏō·rêš rā·‘āh ṯə·ḇō·w·’en·nū
verses.literal: He who searches out good finds favor but evil will come to him who seeks it

verses.original: בּוֹטֵ֣חַ בְּ֭עָשְׁרוֹ ה֣וּא יִפֹּ֑ל וְ֝כֶעָלֶ֗ה צַדִּיקִ֥ים יִפְרָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: bō·w·ṭê·aḥ bə·‘ā·šə·rōw hū yip·pōl wə·ḵe·‘ā·leh ṣad·dî·qîm yip̄·rā·ḥū
verses.literal: He who trusts in his riches . . . will fall but the righteous will thrive like foliage

verses.original: עוֹכֵ֣ר בֵּ֭יתוֹ יִנְחַל־ ר֑וּחַ וְעֶ֥בֶד אֱ֝וִ֗יל לַחֲכַם־ לֵֽב׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ō·w·ḵêr bê·ṯōw yin·ḥal- rū·aḥ wə·‘e·ḇeḏ ’ĕ·wîl la·ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ
verses.literal: He who brings trouble on his house will inherit the wind and the fool will be servant to the wise of heart

verses.original: פְּֽרִי־ צַ֭דִּיק עֵ֣ץ חַיִּ֑ים וְלֹקֵ֖חַ נְפָשׂ֣וֹת חָכָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: pə·rî- ṣad·dîq ‘êṣ ḥay·yîm wə·lō·qê·aḥ nə·p̄å̄·śōṯ ḥā·ḵām
verses.literal: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life and he who wins souls is wise

verses.original: הֵ֣ן צַ֭דִּיק בָּאָ֣רֶץ יְשֻׁלָּ֑ם אַ֝֗ף כִּֽי־ רָשָׁ֥ע וְחוֹטֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: hên ṣad·dîq bā·’ā·reṣ yə·šul·lām ’ap̄ kî- rā·šā‘ wə·ḥō·w·ṭê
verses.literal: If the righteous receive their due on earth how much more . . . the ungodly and the sinner
